reviews.comment: Dr. Geelen is a great prof, so don't be swayed by the negative reviews. Most of the negativity is complaints about the Encando AI platform, which Dr. Geelen didn't get a choice in as he was required to use it. Other than that, he explains concepts quite clearly and is approachable in both office hours and labs if you have any questions.

He is a pretty chill guy, very friendly, actually spends time to get to know you if you talk to him. Just dont like the Encondo AI, the platform we turn our homeworks in. Exam are graded mostly all or nothing. You get the answer wrong you basially get no points.

I didn't have a good experience in this class. In labs, I felt some students received more attention than others (a particular gender ykwim). The required Encando AI platform felt more promotional than helpful. Labs didn't feel aligned with exams, and the course made linear algebra less enjoyable for me. Consider comparing professors if you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hes a good guy but i didn't like his teaching style. Subject was too abstract and he tried to be extremely specific at times which made understanding the concept difficult. It was a new class so i guess he tried his best.

Good prof who is doing his best with a brand new class. Don't really understand why people would not like him as a prof. Generous with points and very down to earth guy. Lectures are very conceptual but still mostly followable and doing extra practice problems on your own time practically guarantees you a B in my opinion. He is very understanding.

For his very 1st time teaching, he did good. Super chill, cancelled class often, gave us free 100% for our quiz grade, and gave us final in advance. No attendance or grades for lab. He can get a bit confusing in lecture, its important you understand material, as exams can be a bit tricky otherwise. This is a brand-new course, but it isn't too bad.

Geelen is a nice guy but a terrible teacher. His lectures we way easier than the material on the exams or homework's so i had teach myself. ChatGpt was my best friend and his encado ai was trash and never helped. Labs sucked and he also gave like no partial credit on the exams. Material wasn't bad but he was terrible at teaching it.
